preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 5,000,000 characters.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.

preconditions.expression: s consists of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.expression: output == min(all possible s' for all partitions of s into at most k parts and for all possible reversals of some parts)
postconditions.description: The output is the lexicographically smallest string s' that can be obtained by splitting s into at most k parts and reversing some of them.
